title: Born at Hotel Duke, an only child
summary: Matassa was born in a hospital, a hotel, and was an only child.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape

blocks.x: The Kennedy's. Were you born at home or in a hospital?
No, in a hospital. In a hospital. Hotel Duke.
So was I. There's always a problem with that when you tell people you were born in a hotel.
Hotel Duke, yeah. God's Hotel? Wait a minute. Pretty fancy place.
You know from out of town, think you were born in a hotel.
You were born in a hotel.
I was an only child, I guess, after they saw me, they gave up.
Yeah, I was wondering. It would seem, you know, the Italians had...
And you were an only child.

Well, part of that was, again, religiously based. It wasn't religiously correct to do anything that's not have children. Mm-hmm. Supposedly that wasn't the primary reason you got married. Mm-hmm. Right. But, you know, one child. They had me.
